errors.inUse: Cannot delete: it is still used by other records.
errors.duplicate: A record with this name already exists.
errors.badShape: The block shape does not add up to the periods (e.g. 2+1+1 for 4 periods).
errors.badJson: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.badFormat: The file is not an export of this app.
errors.dangling: The file refers to names it does not define.
errors.duringAndBand: A lesson cannot be both a support lesson and a band option.
errors.supportNeedsHost: ΣΤ needs the French lesson it runs during.
errors.pupilsOutside: Some selected pupils are not in the lesson's home groups.
errors.hostIsSupport: The host lesson cannot itself be a support lesson.
errors.supportTooLong: The support lesson has more periods than its host.
errors.supportGroups: A support lesson must belong to the host's home groups.
errors.pupilInHost: A pupil of the support lesson is already in the host lesson.
errors.hasSupport: This lesson has support lessons that depend on it.
errors.roomsRequired: "Only these rooms" needs at least one room.
errors.orderSelf: A lesson cannot come after itself.
errors.orderLoop: The order makes a loop (A after B after A) — the timetable would be impossible.
errors.badTimetable: The file is not a solver result (timetable JSON).
errors.timetableMismatch: Some lessons of the file no longer exist (or changed) in the database. Export again, solve again and load the new result.
errors.timetableNoLessons: The file carries no lesson list (older solver output). Load it with npm run import:timetable or solve again.
errors.onlyStHasHost: Only ΣΤ runs during a lesson. For ΑΣΤ and ΕΞΣΤ, set the excused lessons on the Support page.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Overview of the data and the problems to fix before solving.

warnings.title: Problems
warnings.coverage: {n} lessons with pupils who have nothing during them
warnings.badShapes: {n} lessons whose block shape does not match
warnings.pupilsOutside: {n} lessons naming pupils outside their home groups

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.description: Names in the school's coding (e.g. ΗΥ-ΔΟΚΙΜΗ Α. ΒΔ), obligation in periods and reductions (duties, other school).

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: The same subject in another year is a separate record (e.g. Maths year 1 and Maths year 2).

homeGroups.title: Home groups
homeGroups.description: The school's home groups. Open one for its pupils and all its lessons — plain, merged, French with support, electives.

homeGroupDetail.studentsHint: Pupil names and details are edited on the
homeGroupDetail.bulkText: One name per line — they will be added to {group}.

students.title: Students
students.description: Each pupil belongs to one home group. The subset lessons they take part in (French, support, electives) are shown on the right and set on the lessons.

bulk.title: Bulk add pupils
bulk.text: Pick a home group and type one name per line.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.description: One row = one distribution line: subject × teacher × periods for one or more home groups. Empty teacher = vacancy.
lessons.sameRoomShown: Same room for the shown lessons:
lessons.sameRoomHint: Sets, for every lesson the filter shows, whether all its periods are held in one room.

lessonTable.deleteWithSupport: The {n} support lessons that run during it will be deleted too.
lessonTable.crossDay: Across days: last period + 1st of the next day
lessonTable.orderAfter: Comes after {n, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} (rule O1)
lessonTable.orderBefore: {n, plural, one {# lesson comes} other {# lessons come}} after this one (rule O1)

lessonForm.description: Pick the home group(s), subject, teacher and periods. Two or more home groups make a merged lesson.
lessonForm.mergeHint: Two or more home groups = merged lesson (one teacher, one room).
lessonForm.subject: Subject
lessonForm.duringHint: ΣΤ is placed inside the French periods, for pupils who do not attend French.
lessonForm.audienceAll: All pupils of the home groups
lessonForm.afterHint: E.g. Physics ΘΗΨ2α+ΘΗΨ2β after ΘΗΨ2α and ΘΗΨ2β: each period of this lesson in the week comes after one period of every chosen lesson (α, β, joint, α, β, joint…). Periods left over go anywhere after.
lessonForm.afterNoTeacher: Choose a teacher first: their other lessons are listed.
lessonForm.afterNone: The teacher has no other lessons.
lessonForm.fixedSlotsHint: day:periods, e.g. 1:1-7 (Monday 1st–7th), 3:2-7. Empty = left to the solver.
lessonForm.badFixedSlots: Locked periods are written as day:from-to, e.g. 1:1-7, 3:2-7.
lessonForm.roomList: Rooms (click in order of preference, or type them below)
lessonForm.roomHint: Prefer: the solver tries the rooms in the order you picked. Only: exclusively the chosen rooms. "Same room": once a room from the list is chosen, every period of the lesson is held there (hard rule).
lessonForm.excusedHint: ΑΣΤ and ΕΞΣΤ have no host lesson: on the Support page you set which lessons each pupil is excused from.
lessonForm.roomTextPlaceholder: Type or paste in order of preference, e.g. 121, 33, 32 or 121/33/32
lessonForm.crossDayHint: The shape gives the split: the 1st number = last periods of a day, the 2nd = first periods of the next, the rest are placed as usual. E.g. 3+4: last 3, then 1st–4th the next day.
lessonForm.crossDaySplit: Last {end} periods of a day → periods 1–{start} of the next

bands.title: Bands
bands.description: A band is a set of lessons that run at the same time: elective bands, year-wide level groups, parallel core/advanced sections.

bandDetail.explain: All options of a band are placed at the same periods, so they must have the same number of periods. Each pupil in at most one option.

teacherDetail.legend: Click a cell: free → unavailable (hard) → prefer no lesson → free. Click a day for the whole day.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Each rule is hard, soft (weighted) or off. Teacher rules accept per-teacher overrides.
rules.badParams: Parameters must be a valid JSON object.

L1.name: Consecutive block periods
L1.description: The periods of a block (e.g. a double) are consecutive.

L4.name: Cross-day blocks
L4.description: Last period + first period of the next day is allowed only for the day pairs in the parameters.

B1.name: Declared block shape
B1.description: A lesson follows its shape (e.g. 2+1+1). In the real 2026-27 timetable 19% deviate.

B2.name: Blocks on different days
B2.description: Blocks of one lesson go on different days.

P1.name: Band lessons simultaneous
P1.description: All options of a band run at the same periods; a support lesson runs inside its host's periods.

S1.name: One lesson per pupil
S1.description: No pupil is in two lessons at the same period.

T2.name: Max consecutive periods
T2.description: Maximum consecutive teaching periods (max). In the 2026-27 timetable 48% of teacher-days exceed 2.

T4.name: Daily maximum
T4.description: Max periods per day (day7 on 7-period days, day8 on 8-period days). longExempt: long workshops are exempt.

G1.name: Teacher gaps
G1.description: Minimise free periods between a teacher's lessons on a day.

R1.name: One lesson per room
R1.description: No room hosts two lessons at the same period.

R2.name: Room type
R2.description: A lesson takes a room of the required type.

R3.name: Room changes
R3.description: Minimise room changes per teacher per day.

R4.name: Rooms per teacher
R4.description: As few different rooms as possible for each teacher over the week. The weight counts every room beyond the first.

O1.name: Lesson order
O1.description: A lesson with "Comes after" (e.g. Physics ΘΗΨ2α+ΘΗΨ2β after ΘΗΨ2α and ΘΗΨ2β): each of its periods in the week comes after one period of every chosen lesson — α, β, joint, α, β, joint… Set in the lesson form. Soft: every period out of order costs the weight.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The school week and the school name.
settings.weekHint: Monday and Thursday have 8 periods, the other days 7.

data.title: Import / Export
data.description: One JSON file with all the data — backup, transfer to another machine, and the solver's input.
data.exportText: Download everything (teachers, subjects, home groups, pupils, bands, lessons, rules, settings).
data.importText: Choose an export file (older files with groups/pools are upgraded automatically). It is checked first and its contents are shown.
data.mergeHint: Updates records with the same name and adds new ones. Lessons are replaced.
data.replaceHint: Deletes ALL existing data and loads the file.
data.problems: {n} references to names missing from the file

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: The school's rooms with type and capacity. The type (e.g. "Computer lab", "Kitchen") lets a lesson ask for "any room of this type".

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.description: The solver result per teacher, pupil, home group or room. Click a period for the lesson, its band or its support.
timetable.loadHint: The timetable-*.json the solver writes. Lessons are matched by content (subject, groups, teacher, pupils).
timetable.empty: No timetable loaded yet. Solve with the solver and load the JSON here.
timetable.problems: {n} lessons with a different number of periods than the file — lessons changed after the solve
timetable.deleteText: Only the result is deleted; the school data is untouched.

pick.student: Find a pupil (name, register no, group)…

timetable.pickOne: Pick one from the list on the left.

panel.title: Lesson
panel.allPupils: all pupils of the home groups
panel.bandText: All options of the band run at the same time:
panel.otherSupports: Other supports at the same time

support.title: Support
support.description: ΣΤ: one period of Greek and one of Maths, during French. ΑΣΤ and ΕΞΣΤ: they replace the excused lessons set by the ministry. Every pupil must fill all the periods of the week.

issue.tooMany: More than one ΣΤ period in a subject
issue.noRoomInFrench: The ΣΤ do not fit in the French periods

zoneGrid.title: Zone grid
zoneGrid.description: Zones are placed first, by hand, and the rest of the program is built around them. Pick a zone on the left and click cells to set its periods; the solver treats them as locked.
zoneGrid.legend: Shaded: the selected zone's periods. Click a cell to add or remove one.

issue.periods: {zone}: {slots} periods in the grid, its options have {periods}
issue.pupil: {pupils} pupils in two zones at once ({day}/{period}): {zones}
